characters.continuity: Wreck-It Ralph (2012 film), Ralph Breaks the Internet (2018 film), and Wreck-It Ralph comic tie-ins
characters.summary: Wreck-It Ralph possesses immense superhuman physical strength and nigh-indestructible durability suited for his role as an arcade game heavy. He fights primarily in melee range, smashing barriers, vehicles, and opponents with his giant hands and heavy-duty demolition capability.

techniques: Smashing obstacles and opponents with giant fists
Destroyed Turbo and the Cy-Bugs by triggering the Diet Cola Mountain eruption

mechanisms: Superhuman durability capable of surviving falls from extreme heights and heavy arcade hardware impacts
Resilience against conventional arcade obstacles and impacts
Not established by the cited source

weaknesses: Vulnerable to being trapped or contained if separated from solid footing
Prone to emotional distress when rejected by others
Insecurity, which a virus copied into an army of destructive clones
limitations: Dependent on arcade rules and physical architecture of game cabinets in his home game
Lacks ranged energy attacks or magical capabilities

sources.supports: Overview of Wreck-It Ralph, his role as an arcade game villain, his massive physical strength, and his durability.
Sequel feats, digital environment interactions, and internet-scale destruction.

feats.claim: Routinely smashes building structures and arcade cabinets with physical strikes.
Survived falling from great heights inside the internet hub and digital structures.

notableResults.note: Defeated Turbo inside Diet Cola Mountain by smashing the Mentos stalactites to trigger an eruption.
